script:
You are a professional screenwriter.

Write a modern screenplay.

Constraints:
- No guns
- No gun violence
- No weapon combat
- No graphic violence
- No copyrighted characters
- Completely original story

Requirements:
- 10–15 scenes
- Proper screenplay format
- INT/EXT scene headers
- Dialogue in uppercase character format
- Realistic pacing

Genre: Drama
Theme: ambition

Begin screenplay.

INT. NEW YORK APARTMENT - NIGHT

ALEX, late 20s, a determined young woman, sits at her kitchen table, surrounded by stacks of papers and textbooks. She's studying for her law school entrance exam, her face illuminated by the dim light of the lamp.

ALEX
(talking to herself)
I can do this. I will do this.

A knock at the door interrupts her focus. She looks up, startled.

INT. HALLWAY OUTSIDE ALEX'S APARTMENT - NIGHT

A large, menacing figure, MIKE, mid 30s, looms in the hallway. He's a former friend and ex-boyfriend of Alex.

MIKE
(yelling)
Alex! I know you're in there! Open the door!

INT. NEW YORK APARTMENT - NIGHT

Alex hesitates, then stands up and approaches the door.

ALEX
(through the door)
What do you want, Mike? It's late.

MIKE
(angrily)
I want to talk to you, Alex. I've got something important to show you.

INT. LIVING ROOM - NIGHT

Alex opens the door, allowing Mike to enter. He pulls out a folder full of documents.

MIKE
This is an invitation to join a prestigious law firm, Alex. I got it for you. All you have to do is give up on your dreams of going to law school.

Alex's eyes widen in shock and anger.

ALEX
(shouting)
Get out! I don't want your charity or your handouts! I want to earn my place in the world, on my own terms!

Mike sneers, then storms out of the apartment, leaving Alex standing in the doorway, tears streaming down her face.

INT. COFFEE SHOP - DAY

Alex sits at a table, surrounded by books and notes, studying for her exam. A waiter approaches with a cup of coffee.

WAITER
(friendly)
Regular?

Alex nods, her eyes never leaving her books.

INT. LAW SCHOOL CLASSROOM - DAY

Alex sits in a packed lecture hall, listening intently as the professor delivers a lecture on contract law. She takes meticulous notes, her determination stronger than ever.

PROFESSOR
(to the class)
Remember, contract law is about promises. Keeping them, breaking them, and understanding the consequences of both.

INT. NEW YORK APARTMENT - NIGHT

Alex is on the phone with her mother, updating her on her studies.

ALEX
(excitedly)
Mom, I've got this! I'm going to pass the exam and get into a good law school!

MOTHER (over the phone)
(proudly)
I knew you could do it, honey. I'm so proud of you.

INT. COURTHOUSE - DAY

Alex stands in a long line, waiting to take her law school entrance exam. She looks nervous, but determined.

ALEX
(to herself)
I've come this far. I can't give up now.

INT. COURTHOUSE - DAY (LATER)

Alex exits the exam room, looking relieved and exhausted. A fellow test-taker, SARAH, mid 20s, approaches her.

SARAH
(excitedly)
Did you hear? They're projecting a 95% pass rate this year!

Alex smiles, feeling a sense of relief and accomplishment.

ALEX
I think I did it. I think I passed.

INT. NEW YORK APARTMENT - NIGHT

Alex receives the news that she has passed the exam and been accepted into a prestigious law school. She throws her hat in the air in triumph.

INT. LAW SCHOOL - DAY

Alex stands in her new law school classroom, surrounded by her classmates, all of them determined and focused. She looks at them, then at herself, feeling a sense of pride and belonging.

ALEX
(to herself)
I did it. I earned my place in the world. And I'm going to make the most of it.

FADE OUT.

End of screenplay.
